properties.description:
Overview

This feature service contains point-based emergency shelter records for Broward County, Florida. It supports operational tracking of shelter locations and related status information used in emergency management and response activities.

Feature Content
  • Shelters2 includes shelter records with location, capacity, occupancy, status, type, city, and operational attributes such as power generation availability and incident references.
Use Cases
  • Support emergency shelter planning and coordination.
  • Track shelter capacity, occupancy, and availability during incidents.
  • Reference shelter locations in county emergency operations workflows.
Geographic Coverage

The service covers Broward County, Florida, with shelter features managed at the local county level.
